code_style: AI-code. AI-generated attributed primary-paper KS quadrupole benchmark.

publication.title: Decays K_L,S -> pi0 pi0 gamma and K_L,S -> pi0 pi0 e+ e- as probes of chiral dynamics
publication.incorrect_previous_attribution: hep-ph/9307285 is a different paper and must not be used as this source.

normalization_inputs.cut_scope: The20MeV cut is attached only to the charged reference BR preceding Eq6. Eq3 and the quoted neutral BR have no neutral cut. The neutral low-energy fraction is separately integrated.
normalization_inputs.coupling_ratio_authority: Explicit equal-coupling assumption preceding Eq6, not a measured relation.
normalization_inputs.interaction_scale_authority: Lambda of order vector-meson mass in the primary paper; Lambda=m_rho=0.77526GeV is the declared benchmark.
normalization_inputs.lifetime_authority: Initialized Pythia8.317 source values; same frozen native kaon authority as the candidate. No detector or transport changes.

independent_normalization.paper_rounding_note: The approximate4e-3 phase-space factor in Eq5 agrees with a common-pion-mass calculation. Keeping distinct physical charged/neutral masses gives a larger exact ratio; this benchmark does not fit that difference away.

quoted_rate_normalization_scenario.scope: Alternative normalization to the paper rounded Eq6 estimate, using the independently integrated Eq3 spectrum and full neutral phase space. Retained as a model scenario, not an experimental error.

model_template.coefficient_reference: Heiliger-Sehgal1993 Eqs2-6; coefficient from independent charged-reference M1 integral with physical charged/neutral pion masses, equal gM2/gM1=1 and Lambda=m_rho benchmark.
model_template.uncertainty_scope: The photon rate is an equal-coupling/vector-size estimate, not a measurement or an upper bound. Constant lowest-M2 timelike continuation is an explicit finite benchmark; additional timelike operators, form-factor curvature and CP-violating currents are not bounded by this paper.

parameters.meaning: Evaluate the complex epsilonK once in the declared CP convention, multiply the attributed KS current, and add it coherently to the direct term. A separate probability for the indirect term would lose interference.

mixing_input.amplitude_rule: Apply the same complex epsilonK to the opposite CP-eigenstate current before squaring. No parent lifetime, branching-ratio or total-width factor enters an amplitude.
mixing_input.scope: Known indirect CP violation only, in the existing reference-current strong-phase convention. Direct CPV, unknown timelike operators and missing strong-phase/form-factor dependence remain model uncertainties, not a closed omission budget.
mixing_input.strong_phase_note: The realpositive M2 versus electric-current relative sign/strong phase is a central equal-coupling benchmark choice, not a measured interference phase. Total polarization-summed E/M width interference vanishes for any phase, while correlated muon azimuthal density can change. Keep the common phase when comparing the two physical kaons; no invented phase covariance or statistical error.
